_doc: Round 4 SIMPLE (the owner, 2026-10-05/06: "simple like runescape but hard to master like runescape", "make the skills easy hard to master ... think human made think avg IQ"): the Basic control set's helpers (RingAssist, scripts/ring/ring_assist.gd). They act only under Basic (MatchSetup.controls() "basic"), only for this machine's own player in a % ring (his RingMoves on), never for a bot, never under Full. Each drives the player's own keys (the input he would give: Space pressed, a direction held) the way NpcPad drives a bot; none of them ever turns the camera, moves the aim or touches a lock. Every toggle and number here.

recovery._doc: Off the deck (or thrown, in hitstun) with Space HELD, or pressed within mash_window_s (mashing works too): Space no longer jumps by itself; the helper steers toward the nearest lip (lip_in_m inside it) and presses Space for the double jump, then for the Rise, when RingMoves.simulate (the bots' own look-ahead, RingPredict's physics) says that brings him back: the drift alone first (nothing spent), then the earliest press time of press_times_s with the Rise after it at the first of rise_after_s that comes back. Replanned every replan_s (sim_dt steps over horizon_s, at most budget simulations a look); nothing comes back: the lead model's late order (desperate: the double jump falling under the lip + dj_under_m, the Rise falling under the lip + rise_under_m). Its own escape from hitstun when the plan says so.

steer._doc: While thrown (a launch, until he is back on the deck, on the edge or out): with no direction held, a light steer toward the deck's centre: frac of the full steer (the flight's steer read at 0.1 s, then the air drift); a direction held is added to it (his own steer always wins the larger share).

edge._doc: Basic's edge: the grab is automatic (RingMoves); hanging, Space or any direction climbs, and it climbs by itself climb_after_s after the grab unless E or C is held (kept_by). E, a click and C never roll in, attack or let go under Basic (Full's edge options).

blocks._doc: Full-only under Basic: each true is held back from the player's keys under Basic (the keys do nothing): air_dodge (3 in the air), roll (the guard up + a fresh direction), duck and crouch (C on the deck), fast_fall (C in the air), short_hop (Space within the hop's window of a cast's release: always the full jump), edge_options (E, a click, C on the edge). Keys 4 and 5 (Wall, Heal) come in after the player's first win (later_keys; the win kept in GameSettings' match section, key first_win) and always under Full.
